slug: 2022-03-04 Eswatini Data Protection Act 2022 (Act No. 5 of 2022)

facts.fact: The Data Protection Act, 2022 (Act No. 5 of 2022) was assented by King Mswati III and gazetted on 4 March 2022; the page states no commencement date.
The Act establishes a Data Protection Commission with sanction powers.
